description: Delay hours by code for a project+date range, backing the Realized To-Date report's captured-week delay summary. Only activities with a delay_code_id set are counted (matches dvw-jfb-metric-hours-delay-v2's classification). Resolves the display category/code through jfb_project_delay_codes first, falling back to the company-library jfb_delay_codes row it references -- a project-specific custom code (delay_code_id null on the project-delay-code row) has no library row to fall back to, so its own category/code are used directly. Because both apps' codes are picklist/FK-governed rather than free text, this avoids the case-variant cleanup the non-native app needed (sql/2026-06-15_clean_operational_delay_inconsistencies.sql) for its free-text daily_events.delay_category column. Rewritten 2026-09-24. It used to INNER JOIN jfb_project_delay_codes and group by the code, which silently dropped every activity with no delay_code_id -- Torch Lake 152601's week of 2026-09-07 lost 9.72 h of uncoded STARTUP/SHUTDOWN and totalled 10.15 h against the reference app's 19.87 h. The reference groups by the activity's own category text and never looks at the delay code (weeklySummary.ts and realizedToDate.ts, both via isOperationalCategory), so this does the same: no join, one row per category, delay code irrelevant. A row is a delay when its category is not one of the productive ones -- the same allow-list as dvw-jfb-realized-daily-totals-v2's NOH and src/lib/operationalCategory.js. Zero-length activities are excluded, matching the reference's `duration_hours > 0` guard; they used to print as a 0.00 / 0% row.
direct_sql: SELECT btrim(da.category) AS description, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0) AS hours FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da WHERE da.project_id = p_project_id AND da.report_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND da.end_date_time > da.start_date_time AND upper(btrim(da.category)) NOT IN ('ACTIVE DREDGING', 'DREDGING', 'PRODUCTION', 'ACTIVE CAPPING', 'CAPPING', 'ACTIVE PLACEMENT', 'PLACEMENT', 'TRANSITION') GROUP BY btrim(da.category) ORDER BY hours DESC

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the sum to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range -- typically the captured week's Monday.

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range -- typically the captured week's Sunday.

columns.name: description
columns.description: The activity's own category text, e.g. 'Survey' or 'STARTUP/SHUTDOWN' -- one row per distinct category. This is the label the reference app prints; it is NOT the delay code's name, and two categories that map to the same code stay separate, exactly as the reference shows them.

columns.name: hours
columns.description: Summed activity duration in hours for that category over the date range.
